---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Documentation Instructions

- Keep documentation aligned with actual repository behavior.
- Prefer concise, actionable instructions over generic filler.
- Clearly distinguish required steps, optional choices, assumptions, and known limitations.
- Include exact commands only after verifying they match the project scripts and tooling.
- Do not publish secrets, private data, internal credentials, or real user records.
- Update relevant docs when setup, architecture, behavior, configuration, or decisions change.
- Do not claim tests, deployments, backups, or security reviews occurred unless verified.
